hypothesis: RGB patch reconstruction credit through the actual hard spike partition can encourage content-consistent assignments without a learned decoder.
source: Whole SW0097 positive_frozen seed-matched core; no SW0095 or alternate source.

initial_pilot.training_ids: Exact matched SW0097 4096 IDs/order; torch.randperm over registered 70000 pool with seed 117+seed, then pool-row map.
initial_pilot.native_rgb: Existing byte-verified SW0106 uint8 RGB cache in the identical 0..999 plus 1640..70639 pool row order; convert uint8 to float [0,1] once, then native 8x8 patch means.
frozen: registered encoder represented by frozen cached gamma

old_objective: Unchanged phase-primary + 5 * positive product of actual four-component spike Pearson synchrony.

analytic_partition_rgb.classifier: Exact production spike_synchrony_components threshold 0.50, min_group_size 2, settle 32, components=actual component spikes, background largest_component; then spatial_components_to_patch_labels.
analytic_partition_rgb.hard_labels: One-hot H with image-specific columns 0..max(label); column 0 includes removed largest component and every omitted patch.
analytic_partition_rgb.prototype: mu=(W.T @ detached_native_rgb_patch_means)/clamp(W.sum(0)[:,None],min=1e-8), with numerator and denominator live.
analytic_partition_rgb.image_loss: mean((W @ mu - X)^2)/clamp(detached mean spatial RGB variance,1e-6).
analytic_partition_rgb.batch_loss: Ordinary mean over all 16 images, including K=1 and blank images.
analytic_partition_rgb.candidate_total: old_objective + lambda_rgb * batch analytic reconstruction loss.
analytic_partition_rgb.control_total: old_objective only; same source, trainable core parameters, order, optimizer, and update budget.

lambda_calibration: Once from seed0 source, first four exact matched TRAIN batches: 0.25 * median(old eligible-core gradient norm / RGB eligible-core gradient norm). Candidate coefficient artifact is shared unchanged by any later conditional seeds.
real_preflight: For each of first four seed0 TRAIN batches, finite nonzero RGB gradient to actual Q and eligible core; old objective also finite/nonzero.
Exact production hard-label/H equality and exact W.detach()==H.
One fixed count-preserving H-row permutation, with prototype repooling, has positive mean scrambled-minus-real RGB loss over those batches.
Encoder/gamma/cache/source/order provenance verified; graph stays bitwise fixed; throwaway B16 Adam update has finite nonzero gradient and changes an eligible core parameter.
No GT read for preflight, masks, loss, coefficient, or training.

evaluation.readout: Unchanged actual-event, gate, four-component positive-Pearson product classifier; threshold 0.50, min group size 2, largest component background.

scope: Seed0 matched control/candidate pilot only. Seeds1/2 and data-scaling continuation require a later review of this pilot; no automatic fanout.
prohibitions: no coefficient or threshold tuning after preflight failure
